notes: Pleaimd (PLEA) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 meme token for Uniswap v4, built by the swarm. Its no-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals to msg.sender. Transfers use standard ERC-20 balances and allowances without transfer taxes. There are no administrative or further minting functions and no application contracts. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the total supply.
